scripts.dev: node scripts/update-block-config.js dev && pnpm dlx @airtable/blocks-cli run
scripts.prod: node scripts/update-block-config.js prod && pnpm dlx @airtable/blocks-cli run
scripts.release:dev: . .env && pnpm dlx @airtable/blocks-cli set-api-key $AIRTABLE_PAT && node scripts/update-block-config.js dev && pnpm dlx @airtable/blocks-cli release
scripts.release:prod: . .env && pnpm dlx @airtable/blocks-cli set-api-key $AIRTABLE_PAT && node scripts/update-block-config.js prod && pnpm dlx @airtable/blocks-cli release
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
